job_spec.structural_change: landing depth 64 -> 32, h_wcon registered at its pin with per-group kept one-hot selects, M5 slot cell wrapper. r2 (the r1 kit was refused by the clock rule: hclk root 19,280 sinks, measured TT insertion 442.7 ps): (1) landing storage 64 x 281 -> 32 x 281 flops (LD = the controller's credit count CRED 32; every RD holds a credit and credits return from the synchronised read pointer that the full flag uses, so occupancy <= 32; contract: controller CRED <= 32): hclk root ~10.4k sinks; (2) WPIPE 1: h_wcon registered at its pin (completion path h_cv / h_csec / h_cdata / h_ctag one HCLK edge later: h_cv two edges after h_wcon), one kept pin-flop copy and one kept one-hot entry select per storage column group (wc_bin[0] drove 4,629 loads, port h_wcon 584); (3) h_hand (same-edge hand-off, cycle kept) is the select of one final 2:1 mux: hand-off pointer kept as +0/+1/+2 registers (was a 7-level input cone). No logic between a Gray register and its synchroniser.
